entity_set.title: Entity Set
entity_set.description: Select the entity set to extract

output_table_name.title: Output Table Name
output_table_name.description: Name of the output table in Keboola Storage. If empty, entity set name will be used.

select_fields.title: Select Fields
select_fields.description: Select specific fields to extract (leave empty for all fields)

filter_expression.title: Filter Expression
filter_expression.description: OData $filter expression (e.g., Status eq 'Active' and CreatedAt gt 2024-01-01)

expand_properties.title: Expand Navigation Properties
expand_properties.description: Include related entities in the response

order_by.title: Order By
order_by.description: Field name for ordering (e.g., CreatedAt desc)

sync_type.title: Sync Type
sync_type.description: Full sync loads all data, incremental sync loads only new/changed records

incremental_field.title: Incremental Field
incremental_field.description: Field used for incremental sync (e.g., LastChangedAt, ModifiedOn)

primary_key.title: Primary Key
primary_key.description: Fields that form the primary key (required for incremental sync)

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: Override default page size for this entity (leave empty to use default)

max_records.title: Max Records
max_records.description: Override default max records for this entity (0 = unlimited, leave empty to use default)
